title: Kale and Medley Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry featuring kale and mixed vegetables. Perfect as a side dish or add your favorite protein for a complete meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add medley and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add kale and cook until wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
If using grilled chicken, add to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together tartar sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and chicken (if using) and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
